facts.business: Aavas Financiers Limited is a housing finance company providing affordable home loans primarily in Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets across India.
key_risks: rising competition in affordable housing finance
impairment of loans including Expected Credit Losses (ECL) involves significant judgement and estimates
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions executed by the Company during the Financial Year with related parties were on an arm's length basis and were usually in the ordinary course of business. There have been no material significant related party transactions between the Company and its Directors, their relatives or associates.
